messages:
talia: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight "cost_fingerprint" + "cost_level" pair to propagate in headers/envelopes. Aim: attribute spend without exploding time-series cardinality.

mike: can you define those precisely? how do they differ from previous request_class ideas?

talia: cost_fingerprint = stable short token (<=16 chars) chosen by owning service to group related user flows (e.g., signup_v2). cost_level = tiny int 0..4 indicating estimated resource intensity. fingerprint is low-cardinality if teams follow rules.

pranay: where do we enforce low-cardinality? historically teams create one-off values and it blooms.

talia: enforcement plan: 1) fingerprint registry in central schema repo; 2) CI lint in SDK disallowing arbitrary fingerprints; 3) auto-alerts when new fingerprint frequency spikes. Unknowns map to "fp_unknown" with conservative cost_level.

mike: implementation: header names X-RWI-Cost-Fp and X-RWI-Cost-Lvl. for async: include in kafka envelope metadata under "meta.cost_fp" and "meta.cost_lvl". consumers must copy into outgoing calls if they act on behalf of original request.

oliver: sampling implications? if cost_level=4 we should bump trace sampling and store full trace for N days.

neha: agree. also want to avoid fingerprint encoding of PII or feature ids that leak data. add a privacy review gate on registry entries.

jess-bot: note: rollout tasks created: OBS-costfp-schema, OBS-sdk-fp-lint, OBS-kafka-meta-bump, OBS-costmap-sync.

mike: how will metrics pipeline consume this? we should never attach fingerprint to high-cardinality metric series. instead: metrics ingest should map cost_level->approx_cost and increment aggregated counters aggregated_by(cost_fingerprint, cost_level) at hourly resolution only. fine-grained metrics stay untagged.

pranay: what about cross-service credit? a request that fans out should consolidate cost attribution: either attribute to root fingerprint or split by op.

talia: default: root fingerprint ownership. for specialized background jobs, services can emit their own fingerprints but must list them in registry and indicate parent_fp. attribution UI will support root vs local view.

neha: storage/backfill: we won't backfill old traces. provide a best-effort heuristic pipeline that maps past traces to likely fingerprints for 30d window for continuity.

oliver: SDK ergonomics: provide helper to register fingerprint constants and guardrails for dynamic generation. also a debug mode that prints propagation in logs.

mike: can infra own the cost_level->dollars mapping? different ops cost very differently (cpu-bound vs gpu).

talia: yes, infra/optimize will publish versioned mapping config. cost_level is intentionally coarse to allow stable queries. teams request mapping changes via infra PR.

pranay: alerting: add alert when >3 new fingerprints created in a week by the same team, and when fingerprint cardinality for org > threshold.

neha: security: ensure internal tracing filters redact fingerprints when exporting to external partners.

jess-bot: checklist updated: https://go/r/OBS-costfp-rollout (internal). Tasks: #OBS-costfp-schema, #OBS-sdk-lint, #OBS-kafka-envelope, #OBS-costmap.

mike: curious about query UX: product teams will query aggregated spending by fingerprint. we should provide a UI and example queries.

talia: agree. add a docs page with sample query templates and onboarding checklist. also request a short training for product analytics.

pranay: actions?

talia: I'll open the schema PR and create registry template. mike, can you prototype the metrics aggregation change in shadow mode? neha, please own privacy gate for registry. pranay, add SDK lint. jess-bot, add reminder for next sync.

jess-bot: reminder set: next sync Tue 09:00.

mike: one last thought: add a per-fingerprint TTL to registry entries so unused ones are garbage-collected after 90d unless renewed. prevents rot.

neha: +1. include renewal process in docs.

talia: great. thanks team — will post PR links once opened. :thumbsup:
